FAQs

Good to know before you book

Do I have to pay for booking a call?+

No, the call is completely free. It's an opportunity for us to discuss your goals in detail, understand what you're looking for, and explore how I can help grow your business with high-quality video editing and content strategies tailored to your needs.

Do you customize edits per platform?+

Yes. Fast-paced TikTok cuts, cinematic Instagram reels, or long-form YouTube pacing — every edit is built for where it's going to live.

Can you match my brand and style?+

Yes — logo, colors, fonts, caption style and pacing are all set up once and applied consistently across everything we deliver.

What's the usual turnaround?+

3–5 days for short-form content, 5–7 days for long-form. Rush delivery is available for time-sensitive releases.

Do you help with scripts and captions?+

Yes — script tightening and animated, on-brand captions are included to keep videos accessible and watchable with the sound off.
